package orgs

import (
	"context"

	"example.test/tenantjobs/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/tenantjobs/internal/storage/queries/orgs"
)

// SweepStore is the authored sweep adapter.
type SweepStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewSweepStore(db scope.DB) *SweepStore { return &SweepStore{db: db} }

// Record appends one sweep row for the execution's tenant.
func (s *SweepStore) Record(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
) error {
	return s.db.Write(
		ctx,
		e,
		func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
			return queriesOf(tx).RecordSweep(ctx, queries.RecordSweepParams{
				OrgID:   tx.Tenant(),
				Subject: tx.SubjectID(),
			})
		},
	)
}
